facts: Enron Broadband Services operates 25 pooling points globally, with 18 in the United States and the rest internationally.
The build-out of Enron's 18,000-mile global fiber network is near completion.
The Enron Intelligent Network operates as a network of networks providing switching capacity.
The proprietary Broadband Operating System automates the transaction process from capacity request to billing and funds transfer.
The company plans to add at least 10 more pooling points in 2001.
